title: Account-only user access to Genie One is generally available
body: Account-only user access to account-level Genie One is now generally available. Users provisioned through automatic identity management or account-level System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) can use Genie One without being assigned to a workspace or granted a workspace entitlement. Unity Catalog privileges govern the data and assets that each user can access. See [Account-only user access to Genie One](/aws/en/genie-one/account-only-user-access).
